recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if a future publisher/template change removes the full resource table or reintroduces broken generated anchors on ValueSet resource pages.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive technical correction requesting a fix for dead generated links on valueset.html: the "see designation" link from ValueSet.expansion.contains.designation and the analogous recursive contains link did not navigate correctly.
initial_application: The issue was applied by source commit 9734426b100dc8a2f7c986e87cd2630dc7e09d9f, which changed resource templates from <%resource-table%> to <%resource-table-all%>. That makes resource pages include the full structure table and the anchors needed by generated content-reference links.
additional_context: ValueSet is active in source/fhir.ini. The ValueSet StructureDefinition still has the correct contentReference values, so the defect was generated-page behavior rather than ValueSet semantics. Vocab minutes recorded that text changes would not help and sent the ticket to FHIR-I; FHIR-I assigned it to Grahame; a Zulip committers thread records Grahame investigating and fixing the link-rendering behavior.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current templates already use <%resource-table-all%>, combined branch history contains the original FHIR-19721 source commit, and current CI/R5 rendered pages have valueset-definitions.html links plus matching anchors for the reported content references.
